svg.text: Payments Data Platform · Three-Phase Fact Table Optimization · 4.18B → 628M rows (85% reduction)
User-reported average for Power BI reports
● 200+ users impacted by slow page loads
Databricks Gold → Synapse Views → AAS (Full Refresh) → Power BI / Excel
✅ 6 slicers denormalized into fact table columns
Databricks Gold → Synapse Tier3 View → Fabric Semantic Model → Power BI / Excel
Phase 1: Drop 3 Safe FKs + Denormalize 6 Slicers
● Drop GeoId (4,273), ProductId (202), PurchaseId (13,110) — 0 measures each
● Denormalize: Region, Country, Currency, ProductGroup, StorefrontGroup, Commerce
● Replace BinId (2,942,748 distinct BINs) with BinCardType (Credit, Debit, Prepaid, Other)
● Report slicers preserved via denormalized BinCardType column
Phase 3: Drop 8 Unused FKs (0 measures each) ⭐ PRIMARY
● Total dropped cardinality: 148,000+ distinct dimension values
Zero breaking changes · Production-validated · Test T12-T14 PASS
